description: Experience the rich, aromatic flavors of the Middle East with this homemade Chicken Shawarma Spiced Rotisserie. Juicy, tender chicken is infused with a vibrant blend of traditional spices, slow-roasted to perfection on your rotisserie. It's an unforgettable culinary journey that brings the bustling streets of Beirut or Amman right to your dining table.

instructions.title: Prepare the Shawarma Marinade
instructions.text: In a large bowl, whisk together the plain yogurt, fresh lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, ground cumin, ground coriander, smoked paprika, turmeric powder, ground ginger, cayenne pepper, black pepper, and salt until well combined. This is your flavorful shawarma marinade.

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
instructions.text: Pat the whole chicken thoroughly dry with paper towels. This helps the marinade adhere and promotes crispy skin. Generously rub the prepared shawarma marinade all over the chicken, ensuring to get it under the skin where possible and inside the cavity. If desired, stuff half a sliced onion into the cavity for extra aroma. Place the chicken in a large resealable bag or covered dish and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, to allow the flavors to penetrate.

instructions.title: Preheat Rotisserie and Oven/Grill
instructions.text: About 30 minutes before cooking, remove the chicken from the refrigerator to bring it closer to room temperature. Preheat your oven or grill with a rotisserie attachment to a medium-high heat, around 375F (190C). Ensure a drip pan is placed underneath to catch any juices and fat.

instructions.title: Skewer the Chicken for Rotisserie
instructions.text: Carefully thread the marinated chicken onto the rotisserie spit. Secure the chicken tightly with rotisserie forks on both ends, making sure it is balanced. Use kitchen twine to truss the legs together and tie down the wings close to the body. This prevents them from flopping during rotation and ensures even cooking.

instructions.title: Rotisserie Cook to Perfection
instructions.text: Place the spit onto the rotisserie motor in your oven or grill. Cook for approximately 35-50 minutes, or until the internal temperature of the thickest part of the thigh (without touching bone) reaches 165F (74C) and the skin is beautifully golden brown and crispy. Cooking time may vary based on chicken size and rotisserie setup.

instructions.title: Rest, Carve, and Serve
instructions.text: Once cooked, carefully remove the chicken from the rotisserie and transfer it to a cutting board. Tent it loosely with foil and let it rest for 10-15 minutes. This allows the juices to redistribute, resulting in a more tender and flavorful chicken. Carve the chicken against the grain into thin slices, mimicking traditional shawarma. Serve hot with warm pita bread, tahini or garlic sauce, fresh vegetables, and pickles for an authentic Middle Eastern feast.

tips: For a deeper flavor, marinate the chicken for a full 24 hours. The longer it marinates, the more intense the shawarma spices will become.
If you dont have a rotisserie, you can roast the chicken in a conventional oven at 400F (200C) for 60-75 minutes, flipping halfway, or until cooked through.
Serve your rotisserie shawarma with a homemade garlic sauce (Toum), fresh chopped salad, pickles, and warm pita bread for the ultimate experience.
